description: InventoryService.lookup accepts an asset-visibility function; omitted means no assets are returned (deny by default).
Unreadable asset rows are removed before domains is computed, so multi collapses to a single type and asset collapses to none.
ApiInventoryController builds the authorizer: asset:read short-circuit, then authorizeApiResourceRead per row using resolveAssetAuthorizationRecords.
Denial is silent: response shape identical to a code that matched nothing.
resolveAssetAuthorizationRecords moved to packages/assets/src/lib/assetRecordAuthorization.ts and imported by assetActions.ts.
ScanResultCard tests cover an asset-less multi and a none result.
